key_points: Late‑stage Sjögren’s disease trial met primary endpoint, showing statistically significant and clinically meaningful benefit
Positive market reaction: stock jumped on news, Citi notes open questions but generally upbeat
Sale‑leaseback of Deerfield campus generated $151 million cash, modestly strengthening balance sheet
Analyst commentary (Motley Fool, simplywall) highlights trial as a catalyst for future growth
Valuation gap (DCF $189 vs price $415) remains large; upside dependent on regulatory approval and commercialization
